notes: Group: Everything Else (LIGHT SIDE). FULL portrait site overlay printed sideways that RENAMES the site: both bars read '•YAVIN 4: JEDI ACADEMY' (red • on the Light bar, white • on the Dark bar). Art window blank. Light half (right bar, grey text box) = game_text, one line, ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Dark half (left bar, black text box) = dark_text, one line, with the black EPISODE I icon inline: 'non-[Episode I] Jedi' (a space is printed between the icon and 'Jedi') → {episode1}; curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Force slots: Light bar TWO blue sabers (as the printed Light Force ×2), Dark bar TWO red sabers (dark_force_count 2) — the printed card has NO Dark Force icon. Icon boxes on both bars, outermost first: planet (pink planet), exterior (orange sun) — same as printed; no scomp ring. Credits across the bottom border with the VS16 set sphere between them: left 'Original concept by Charles Clarkson', right 'New York States 2006' → credit_bottom (list). No Episode I icon in the margin. BASE: caption names Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins (A New Hope Light site; printed Light text 'If you control, with a leader here, your starships are each power +1 at Death Star system.', Dark 'If you control, Force drain +1 here.').
